children: Amrize reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $3.77B, up 2.2% year over year, while net income increased 3.1% to $559M and diluted EPS rose 4.1% to $1.02. Revenue growth reflected pricing, acquisitions and surcharges, partly offset by lower volumes.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to the Company”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share attributable to the Company”.
Building Materials accounted for 75.4% of revenue, while Building Envelope represented 24.6%, slightly higher than a year earlier.
Building Materials revenue rose 1.8% and Adjusted EBITDA increased 2.7%, supported by pricing and acquisitions.
Building Envelope revenue grew 3.6% on higher volumes and pricing, but Adjusted EBITDA declined 14.6% amid freight and raw material costs.
Amrize said its ASPIRE program targets procurement, logistics and operating efficiencies, while inflationary cost pressures are expected to continue into 2027.
